answer_1.quote: We propose the Diagram-Driven Course Questions Generation (DDCQG) task, which aims to generate questions based on diagrams for specific courses...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using established language generation metrics, including BLEU, Bert Score, METEOR, CIDEr, and ROUGE. ... we introduce the FLEUR evaluation index to supplement the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: A separate group of subject annotators evaluated all samples based on their educational utility using a 100-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated question on educational utility using a 100-point scale.
